_comment: Tier-1 heal. Bark + clay + lichen pressed together into a dressing. Crude in technique but reliable -- the entry-tier medicinal preparation. Per [[project_healing_system_locked_2026_06_14]].
name: Poultice
description: A small, sticky mass of bark, clay, and lichen worked together between the palms. Pressed against a wound, it draws and binds at once.
